name: gpt
description: Run OpenAI GPT models as Claude Code subagents on the session's own tools

effort.title: GPT effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort for every GPT step. "inherit" (default) uses the Agent call's effort, else the session's; a level overrides both.

maxSteps.title: GPT step cap
maxSteps.description: A GPT run stops after this many model steps and reports that the cap was reached.

maxUsd.title: GPT cost cap (USD)
maxUsd.description: A GPT run stops once its estimated OpenAI cost reaches this many dollars.

web.title: GPT web access
web.description: Give GPT OpenAI's hosted web search (search, open page, find in page), run at OpenAI under OpenAI's site access and safeguards, outside Claude Code's permissions. Each search costs $0.01 plus content tokens. Every web action is listed in the subagent's transcript.
